completedActions.description: Cleaned up 11 warnings in scv-core by fixing nil-coalescing, unused variables, redundant conformances, and downcasts
Discovered genuine data race: PaliCounter reads mlDoc from background thread while UI mutates currentScid on main thread
Analyzed actor boundary issue: EbtData (actor) returns MLDocument (non-Sendable) requiring @unchecked Sendable workaround
Designed solution: Extract segment building to EbtData.segmentsForSuttaRef() returning [Segment]? (already Sendable)
Made instance method getMLDocument() internal (EbtData.swift:592) - only called by static wrapper, hide non-Sendable return from public API
Made getDocument() private (EbtData.swift:632) - only called internally by instance getMLDocument()
Created doc/MLDocument.md - comprehensive API documentation with trilingual segment overview and all properties

Encapsulated MLDocument: made all 35 properties private, exposed only 6 fields needed by callers (segMap public var, sutta_uid/docLang/docAuthor/docAuthorName public private(set), currentScid public var)
Identified unused MLDocument fields through compiler-driven testing - all 29 other fields completely unused and can be removed in future refactor
Verified build succeeds (scv-core and scv-ui) with encapsulated properties and @Model macro

Established MLDocument encapsulation pattern: segMap remains public var (needs mutation during segment merge), sutta_uid/docLang/docAuthor/docAuthorName use public private(set) (immutable after init), currentScid remains public var (UI mutates for selection). Pattern enables safe factory method implementation outside actor.

Create static factory MLDocument.create(suttaRef:docSegments:pliSegments:) in MLDocument.swift. Takes Sendable segment dictionaries and builds enriched MLDocument by merging pli text into doc segments (handles pli/non-pli logic). Factory runs outside actor, receiving only Sendable data.
